description: This file defines the class ControlledFaultInjectionTransactionTestRunner, which extends TransactionTestRunnerBase, and provides methods to perform and test fault-injected transaction operations on grains in Orleans framework, including single and multi-grain transactions with fault injection scenarios.

classes.name: ControlledFaultInjectionTransactionTestRunner
classes.description: A test runner class for executing fault-injected transaction tests on grains within Orleans framework.

methods.name: SingleGrainReadTransaction
methods.description: Performs a read transaction on a single grain, verifies the set and get methods, and deactivates the grain.

methods.name: SingleGrainWriteTransaction
methods.description: Performs a write transaction on a single grain, adding a delta to its value and verifying the update.

methods.name: MultiGrainWriteTransaction_FaultInjection
methods.description: Performs a coordinated multi-grain write transaction with fault injection, including fault handling and retries.
